# The Future of Illustration — fundamentals self-quiz (Advanced, public edition)
# Run: python3 quiz.py
qa = [
    ("What is Style?", "the consistent visual voice clients hire."),
    ("What is Editorial illustration?", "visual commentary on articles and ideas."),
    ("State one governing principle of illustration.", "Value structure: readable light-dark design preceding color."),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    print(f"A{i}: {a}")
    score += 1
print(f"Quiz complete: reviewed {score} of {len(qa)} key points.")
